answer:
There is no catalog item called exactly ansible-lightspeed-coding-lab. The lookup returns found: false and four near matches:

- ansible-lightspeed-coding-lab-aws: repo agnosticv, account ansible_bu
- ansible-lightspeed-coding-lab-azure: repo agnosticv, account ansible_bu
- ansible-lightspeed-coding-lab-cnv-sandbox: repo agnosticv, account sandboxes_gpte (a single-user internal test edition)
- ansible-lightspeed-coding-lab-cnv: repo partner-agnosticv, account partner_ansible

The partner edition on OpenShift Virtualization is ansible-lightspeed-coding-lab-cnv. It is the only one in the partner repository, rhpds/partner-agnosticv, under partner_ansible. The other CNV entry is the internal sandboxes_gpte test edition in rhpds/agnosticv.

Its configuration, rhpds/partner-agnosticv partner_ansible/ansible-lightspeed-coding-lab-cnv/common.yaml, sets:
- num_users: 25, so one order hosts 25 attendees
- ocp4_installer_version: "4.17", so it installs OpenShift 4.17
- cloud_provider: openshift_cnv, built from the partner-cnv-emea cluster pool

Don't plan with the AWS edition's numbers (40 users, OpenShift 4.18) or the CNV sandbox's (1 user, 4.16). They are different catalog items.
